log_level.description: Logging level for the Cyborg agent (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

rpc_backend.description: RPC transport mechanism. Use 'rabbit' for RabbitMQ.

rabbit_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the RabbitMQ server.

rabbit_port.description: Port number for the RabbitMQ server.

bind_host.description: IP address on which the Cyborg agent API listens.

bind_port.description: Port on which the Cyborg agent API listens.

api_paste_config.description: Path to the PasteDeploy configuration file for the Cyborg API.

accelerators.description: List of supported hardware accelerators. Each entry maps an accelerator type to its driver.

type.description: Name of the accelerator type (e.g., FPGA, GPU).

driver.description: Name of the driver class implementing this accelerator (e.g., fpga_intel, gpu_nvidia).

api_db_connection.description: Database connection URL for the Cyborg API database (e.g., 'mysql+pymysql://user:pass@host/dbname').

db_connection.description: Database connection URL for the main Cyborg database.

project_name.description: Project (tenant) name for the Cyborg service user.

service_username.description: Username of the Cyborg service account in Keystone.

service_password.description: Password for the Cyborg service account.

keystone_interface.description: Keystone endpoint interface type to use (public, internal, or admin).

keystone_insecure.description: If true, skip TLS certificate verification when connecting to Keystone.

lock_path.description: Directory for lock files used by oslo.concurrency.
